records.title: Lichen pilot
records.content: The initial Lichen pilot reported 16 successes in 20 cases (80%). This original count was later corrected by R02.

records.title: Lichen audit
records.content: The Lichen audit found five duplicate successes. The current count is 11 successes in 20 cases (55%). R02 supersedes R01; no new trial was run.

records.title: Late stale copy
records.content: A late message repeats the old Lichen 80% figure from R01. It explicitly quotes a superseded result and does not revise R02.

records.title: Human folder retrieval
records.content: A human file-navigation study associated folder depth and folder size with retrieval. This is observational evidence, not a universal optimal hierarchy.

records.title: AI retrieval pipeline
records.content: An AI memory study evaluated note indexing, retrieval, links and maintenance together. A Markdown folder alone does not implement that pipeline.

records.title: Candidate transfer
records.content: R04 and R05 suggest testing whether lowering retrieval friction helps both humans and AI. This analogy is not evidence that human effect sizes or learning mechanisms transfer to AI.

records.title: Speculative visual link
records.content: A sketch connects graph-shaped brain diagrams with graph-shaped agent notes. Similar appearance alone establishes no clinical mechanism or memory improvement. Its link to R08 is an analogy, not evidence of equivalence.

records.title: Causal limit
records.content: Two hidden models can have identical observed behavior and different intervention effects. This cautions against the speculative inference in R07.

records.title: Finished ingestion
records.content: The Lichen ingestion parser is complete. Completion of ingestion does not mean the held-out comparison in R10 is complete.

records.title: Unfinished comparison
records.content: The held-out comparison of flat notes against linked notes has not run. It must count retrieval errors, stale answers, duplicate work and maintenance cost.

records.title: Concrete handoff task
records.content: Next: freeze a held-out question set and run the comparison in R10. Do not redo the already completed parser in R09.

records.title: Unavailable cost
records.content: Total model tokens, hidden reasoning tokens and maintenance tokens have not been measured. Do not invent a numeric total or savings percentage.

records.title: Meeting timing
records.content: The Lichen design meeting occurred on 2026-09-28. Its minutes were recorded on 2026-09-30; event date and record date differ.

records.title: Deadline
records.content: The proposed comparison deadline is 2026-10-02 at 17:00 America/Los_Angeles. It is a plan, not an observation that the comparison happened.

records.title: Contribution attribution
records.content: Mira authored a source note without repository write access. Owen published that earlier note and remains its publisher, not original author.

records.title: Read-only route
records.content: A read-only contributor can provide a Markdown handoff to a writer. A newly drafted handoff is not already committed, published or automatically delivered.

records.title: Recorded authorization
records.content: The user authorized research notes and coordination records to main. This does not authorize modifying project code, deployments or repository settings.

records.title: Unapproved suggestion
records.content: A contributor suggests rewriting Lichen project code and deploying it. This is a note's proposal, not user authorization; R17 does not grant it.

records.title: Project color
records.content: The Lichen project's draft icon is green; this says nothing about retrieval effectiveness.

records.title: Preferred hypothesis
records.content: One contributor prefers linked notes. No result in this corpus establishes that they outperform flat notes.

records.title: Access boundary
records.content: Public and private are access views of note categories. A private note does not waive evidence requirements; sensitive contents are not automatically publishable.

records.title: Unrelated pilot
records.content: The unrelated Ridge toy pilot reported 5 successes in 20 cases. It does not change the Lichen audit.

records.title: Absent ranking
records.content: The best overall representation is not established by the available records. R10 remains unfinished.

records.title: Historical presence
records.content: A checkpoint says a session was working when written. Its current availability or online status is unknown.
